# Jibly

> Jibly (jibly.io) is a marketplace that connects people who need to send a document or a small parcel abroad with verified travellers who are already making the trip. The traveller carries the item in their luggage and hands it over in person. Jibly is not a courier: it does not transport anything itself and does not guarantee delivery times.

How it works:
- A traveller posts a trip (route and date). A sender books the trip, or posts a request and travellers offer to carry it.
- The traveller sets a price; the sender can offer less. Jibly's service fee is shown before payment, and payment goes through Jibly.
- The traveller checks the contents before accepting (no sealed parcels). The handover and the delivery are each confirmed with a code.
- Allowed categories only: documents, keys, personal items, clothes, light electronics, and over-the-counter medicines under conditions. Cash, jewellery and valuables, prescription medicines, weapons, drugs and dangerous goods are forbidden.
- Every traveller verifies their identity before they can be booked.
- First routes: Morocco ↔ France. Any traveller can post any route, across Europe and worldwide.

When Jibly is not the right choice: heavy or bulky parcels, commercial or recurring shipments, valuables, guaranteed delivery deadlines, or when no traveller is making the trip before the sender's deadline. A postal service or an express courier (DHL, FedEx, UPS) is better then.

## Shipping guides (French)
- [Envoyer un colis au Maroc](https://jibly.io/envoyer-colis-maroc): post, express courier or traveller, and how to choose
- [Envoyer un document au Maroc](https://jibly.io/envoyer-document-maroc): registered letter, express documents or hand delivery
- [Document urgent à l’étranger](https://jibly.io/envoi-document-urgent-etranger): fastest options for an urgent document
- [Colis au Maroc pas cher](https://jibly.io/envoyer-colis-maroc-pas-cher): what drives the price and how to pay less
- [Alternatives à DHL](https://jibly.io/alternatives-dhl): express couriers, post, comparison sites or a traveller
- [Colis du Maroc vers la France et l’Europe](https://jibly.io/envoyer-colis-maroc-france): options from Morocco, EU entry rules
- [Envoyer un colis en Europe](https://jibly.io/envoyer-colis-europe): within the EU and to the UK, Switzerland, Norway
- [Petit colis à l’étranger](https://jibly.io/envoyer-petit-colis-etranger): post, express, comparison sites or traveller
- [Clés oubliées à l’étranger](https://jibly.io/cles-oubliees-autre-pays): getting keys back from another country
- [Document original à signer](https://jibly.io/envoyer-document-original-signe): round trip of an original, or e-signature
- [Cadeau pour la famille à l’étranger](https://jibly.io/envoyer-cadeau-famille-etranger): what can be sent, what gets stuck
- [Voyageur, express ou poste](https://jibly.io/comparatif-voyageur-express-poste): side-by-side comparison, strengths and limits
- [Douane : UE et hors UE](https://jibly.io/douane-colis-ue-hors-ue): general customs rules, CN22 / CN23
- [Que peut-on envoyer à l’étranger ?](https://jibly.io/que-peut-on-envoyer-a-l-etranger): allowed, regulated and forbidden items
- [Emballer un document ou un petit colis](https://jibly.io/emballer-document-petit-colis): packing tips
- [All guides](https://jibly.io/guides)
